verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships a built-in web UI and an agent platform, so an integrated document workspace is a fair question for it, but the evidence never describes one. The closest items are a shell agent (`local-ai chat`) that reads files and runs commands behind an approval gate, and the ability to edit saved chat messages. Neither is an integrated document drafting and editing workspace with automatic saving.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an AI agent draft and edit documents in an integrated workspace with changes saved automatically
